card.name: Digits in dose and time amounts
card.fires_on: The digit 5 or the 0 of 10 inside a number just before a unit such as mg, mL or minutes, in dosing and administration instructions.

modes.label: Time amount
modes.description: A number like 5 right before the word minutes in handling instructions.
modes.example: Do not leave the cap off for more than <<5>> minutes as this can dry out the solution

modes.label: Dose amount
modes.description: The final 0 of 10 (or a 5) in a dose or volume before mg, mg/kg or mL.
modes.example: Patients should initiate therapy at 1<<0>> mg/kg/day to 15 mg

card.writes: It pushes the model to write minutes next, though the unit is often mg or mL.
card.plain: It marks the last digit of a small round number in a dose or timing instruction, just before the unit.
